fields.hero_prompt: Build a mattress quiz for my store that asks how shoppers sleep and matches each one to a bed on my showroom floor.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a mattress quiz?

faq_plan.hint: Do i need a new mattress quiz?

quiz_plan.promise: the quiz plays the page's promise: a mattress quiz a visitor can take, whose results answer what the H1 says it builds

plan.angle: All ten results for mattress quiz are mattress brands and retailers running their own product finders (Ashley, Sleep Foundation, Helix, GoodBed, Sleep Number, Healthline, Serta, Saatva, Zinus, Purple). Each recommends only the brand's own beds and shows nothing of how the finder is built. This page gives the searcher both: a 7-question mattress quiz to take on the page that names a mattress type from sleep position, feel, bounce and warmth, then four finders a showroom, an online brand, a furniture store and a review site run as their own app, with every answer saved to a database they own.
tab_stories: Penlow Sleep Shop's website quiz ends each result on one of its floor models with a button to book a showroom visit, and 58 of the 214 shoppers who finished it in October booked one.
Hushwood Sleep Co. saves each shopper's quiz answers with the order, finds that 19 of its 31 trial returns came from hot sleepers matched to the all-foam model, and moves hot sleepers to the hybrid.

Moorhaven Home's quiz asks both partners the same firmness question, and when the two answers sit 3 or more points apart on its 10-point scale the lead goes to a salesperson in Slack; 23 of 90 couples did in March.
The Pillow Ledger runs a free quiz for its readers, and a monthly count shows 512 of 1,240 takers landing on soft foam, so next month's reviews cover soft foam models.
